Meet The Bearded Crew

Family owned, community powered.

Bearded Junk Removal is led by Timothy Reeves and the Reeves family—longtime residents of Southeast Arizona who believe hard work and service go hand in hand. From our first phone call to the final sweep, we show up with smiles, strong backs, and a commitment to treating your property like our own.

We donate usable items to local nonprofits, recycle responsibly, and give back by supporting community cleanups and neighborhood events. When you book with us, you get a licensed, insured crew that cares about keeping Tucson, Vail, and every surrounding community looking its best.

  • Local, Christian small business

Common Questions

How does pricing work?

Pricing is based on the volume your items take up in our trucks. We quote before we start, so there are zero surprises.

Do I need to move anything?

Nope. Point to what goes and we’ll safely remove it from wherever it is—attics, basements, backyards, or job sites.

What items can't you take?

We can’t haul hazardous materials like paint, oil, chemicals, or propane. We’re happy to recommend proper disposal resources.
